subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose `agents.defaults.compaction.turnMaintenanceTaskTimeoutMs` and `CommandQueueEnqueueOptions.onTaskTimeout` as supported contracts for deferred-maintenance recovery?
rationale: The lifecycle defect has a mechanical repair, but the proposed operator setting and generic core callback are durable product/API choices that code review cannot authorize.

options.title: Accept after lifecycle fix
options.body: Approve both opt-in contracts after the delayed-persistence race is repaired and fresh-install and upgrade behavior remain proven.

options.title: Narrow to existing policy
options.body: Reuse an existing compaction or session timeout setting and keep the timeout fence private to context-engine maintenance.

options.title: Pause contract expansion
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers define the canonical recovery and configuration contract for deferred maintenance.

recommendation.title: Accept after lifecycle fix
recommendation.body: Approve both opt-in contracts after the delayed-persistence race is repaired and fresh-install and upgrade behavior remain proven.
